id.description: Stable identifier for this character, with a required namespace (for example base:gagaa).

name.description: Display name shown in the editor and game.

defaultPortrait.description: Relative path of the portrait shown when the character has no portrait for the line's emotion.

portraits.description: Relative path of the portrait image for each emotion, keyed by emotion ID.

typewriterSound.description: ID of the typewriter sound played while this character speaks, unless an emotion overrides it.

emotionTypewriterSounds.description: Typewriter sound ID per emotion ID, replacing the character's default sound for lines with that emotion.

walkSpeed.description: Walking speed in tiles per second, before boons and other modifiers. Absent = 4. NPC routines use it to time each walk.

startingSocialStanding.description: How much this character thinks of the player in a new game, from 0 (lowest) to 100. Absent = 50.

dialogues.description: What talking to the character starts when no quest and no routine sets a dialogue. The first entry whose condition is true wins; an entry without a condition always matches. With no match the character cannot be talked to.

dialogue.description: ID of a dialogue, for example base:fabia_greeting.

condition.description: Read-only Lua expression, checked when the player starts talking (for example SocialStanding.HasMoreThan('base:fabia', 70)). Omit for always true.

dialogueRules.description: Editor source of dialogues: rows of a decision table that Vulcanus compiles into dialogues when saving. Unity reads only dialogues.

standing.description: A standing band id, optionally followed by + (or better) or - (or worse).

folderPath.description: Virtual folder path for workspace organization (e.g. 'NPCs/Villagers'). Empty string or absent = root.
